title: U.S. Fast-Tracked Deportation of Ecuadorean Politician Despite Torture Fears
summary: The removal of José Serrano, a critic of President Daniel Noboa who has been accused of criminal activity, underscores how the Trump administration has asserted control over U.S. immigration courts.
